subject: Dependency mapping and phased canary deployment plan for StratusBank RFI
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stratusbank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@stratusbank.com
Date: 2027-05-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFI follow-up: detailed implementation timeline and dependency matrix

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the overview last week. As part of our RFI evaluation we need a consolidated dependency mapping, an implantation timeline (high level + week-by-week for first 12 weeks), and a proposed phased canary rollout plan that minimizes disruption to our production traffic. Specifically:

- A list of integration touchpoints (SAML, SCIM, audit logs, API gateways, network egress/IPs).
- Any infra/network pre-reqs (ports, NAT, VPC peering).
- Rollout gates (what success looks like at each phase).
- Fallback & rollback steps and estimated RTO/RPO.

Can you provide a document we can share with our engineering and security teams by next Tuesday? We may also ask for a short walkthrough call with your deployment engineering team.

Appreciate it,
Marta
Procurement & Cloud Integrations
StratusBank

---
[external attachment referenced: RFI-questions-v3.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stratusbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: RFI follow-up: detailed implementation timeline and dependency matrix

Marta —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a draft dependency map and a week-by-week 12-week onboarding timeline tailored to the StratusBank scope. Highlights up front:

- Integration touchpoints we propose: SAML SP integration (IdP-initiated + SCIM provisioning), private API gateway peering or secure egress with static IPs, syslog-compatible audit streaming, and optional on-prem inference connector for regulated workloads.
- Network: we recommend either VPC peering (preferred) or site-to-site VPN. Ports 443/22 (management only) + ephemeral for internal control plane; full details in the network sheet.
- Phased canary: 4-phase approach — smoke & validation (non-prod), pilot (1% traffic), measured ramp (10% → 50%), full cutover. Each phase lasts 1–3 weeks depending on telemetry.
- Rollback: auto-fallback to existing endpoints via DNS+LB weight adjustments; expected RTO 5-15 minutes for most regressions.

Attachments: redwood-dependency-map-v1.pdf, network-requirements-stratusbank.xlsx

I'll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next Tuesday 10:00 AM ET unless you prefer another slot. Laura and Vivek — tagging you for a quick review of the plan and the proposed validation gates.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwood.com | +1 (555) 212-9988

[Attachment: redwood-dependency-map-v1.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stratusbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: RFI follow-up: detailed implementation timeline and dependency matrix

Thanks Priyom — good draft. A few suggested edits before we send to StratusBank:

1) Add an explicit privacy/data flow diagram calling out what data leaves the bank environment vs what remains in-customer. That helps their compliance team.
2) Expand the rollback section to include a canary-health checklist (latency, error rate, semantic drift alerts) and specific thresholds for automatic rollback.
3) Under network pre-reqs, call out our recommendation for allowlisting TLS interceptors and the expected certificate chain behavior for SCIM/SAML flows.

I'll inline minor language edits and return a redlined PDF by EOD tomorrow. Vivek — can you validate the proposed ramp percentages and the SLA-limited fallback timings?

—Laura

Laura — quick note: ramp percentages look good but recommend an intermediate 25% check after the 10% window for services with high statefulness (KV cache warming / session affinity). Also:

- Add a short 'observability gating' section: required telemetry (p50/p95 latency, token throughput, 5xx rate, model quality regression signal from synthetic prompt set).
- For rollback RTO, call out that worst-case dependency failures (e.g., SCIM provisioning error causing auth issues) could push an RTO to ~60 minutes while we reconcile identity sync states; include manual reconciliation playbook reference.

I'll append the observability list and the manual reconciliation steps to the network spreadsheet.

Vivek
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
